notes.title: Master Game Season 2
notes.content:
[h3]Hey guys, the new season has started! What are you waiting for
Participate in the Master Game to compete with players from all over the world and get colorful and cool name effects! At the end of the season, you have a chance to claim rich rewards and game resources.[/h3]
